claim: Projections from PPG neurons are elevated in leptin-deficient Lepob/ob mice compared with controls.
source: Here, we visualized projections of PPG neurons in leptin-deficient Lepob/ob mice and found that projections from PPG neurons are elevated compared with controls, and PPG projections were normalized by targeted rescue of leptin receptors in LepRbTB/TB mice, which lack functional neuronal leptin receptors.
evidence: This is supported by quantitative immunohistochemistry and genetic labeling data showing increased GLP-1 fiber density in the PVH of Lepob/ob mice.

claim: PPG projections were normalized by targeted rescue of leptin receptors in LepRbTB/TB mice.
source: Here, we visualized projections of PPG neurons in leptin-deficient Lepob/ob mice and found that projections from PPG neurons are elevated compared with controls, and PPG projections were normalized by targeted rescue of leptin receptors in LepRbTB/TB mice, which lack functional neuronal leptin receptors.
evidence: This is supported by data showing that GCG-Cre::LepRbTB/TB mice have GLP-1 fiber densities similar to wild-type controls.

claim: LepRbTB/TB mice lack functional neuronal leptin receptors.
source: Here, we visualized projections of PPG neurons in leptin-deficient Lepob/ob mice and found that projections from PPG neurons are elevated compared with controls, and PPG projections were normalized by targeted rescue of leptin receptors in LepRbTB/TB mice, which lack functional neuronal leptin receptors.
evidence: This is supported by citation (Berglund et al., 2012) describing the LepRbTB/TB mouse model.

claim: Lepob/ob mice displayed increased levels of neuronal activation in the PVH following vagal stimulation.

evidence: This is supported by Fos immunoreactivity data following CCK injection.
